family_scope: Independent V3 reconstruction of the six stronger V1/V2 biological mechanisms that are not discharged by merely renaming the narrower foundational Biology claims.

mechanism_obligations.name: autocatalytic origin-of-life ignition
mechanism_obligations.required_result: For a complete m-role driven autocatalytic carrier, m-1 internally supported roles plus one supplied seed is the least one-act closure boundary; fewer supported roles cannot close in one act.
mechanism_obligations.scope_limit: Conditional on the explicitly retained compartment, drive, resources and complete role grammar; not a claim that life must appear in every environment.

mechanism_obligations.name: homochiral selection and amplification
mechanism_obligations.required_result: A held parity orientation selects one of two chiral labels and exact finite successor amplification gives shares 2^t/(2^t+1) and 1/(2^t+1), with strictly increasing selected-hand dominance and no finite extinction claim.
mechanism_obligations.scope_limit: The mathematical orientation is derived before source access; L-amino-acid and D-sugar naming is an external observational correspondence.

mechanism_obligations.name: somatic and germ-line ageing split
mechanism_obligations.required_result: The carrier 1/(2^a q), q odd, has exactly a transient Fold steps before the odd-denominator recurrent orbit; an odd denominator begins recurrently without that transient.
mechanism_obligations.scope_limit: Exact carrier discriminator, not an unsupported assertion of organismal immortality or a universal chronological rate.

mechanism_obligations.name: excitable neural threshold
mechanism_obligations.required_result: Half-One is the least normalized activation whose doubled support completes One; sub-threshold input emits structural absence and the event and refractory records remain distinct.
mechanism_obligations.scope_limit: Exact normalized event law, not an imported universal membrane-voltage value.

mechanism_obligations.name: differentiation-loss cancer mechanism
mechanism_obligations.required_result: The mechanism is the conjunction of a persistent nonterminal lineage cycle, loss of a required differentiation transition and escape from the division/death/differentiation control relation; cycling alone is insufficient.
mechanism_obligations.scope_limit: Finite lineage-control mechanism, not a claim that every cancer has one molecular cause.

mechanism_obligations.name: bounded-orbit ecosystem stability
mechanism_obligations.required_result: The exact Fold orbit of 3/5 is 3/5, 1/5, 2/5, 4/5 and return to 3/5, giving a bounded period-four carrier with every state retained.
mechanism_obligations.scope_limit: Exact stability of the declared finite carrier, not a universal period for every ecosystem.

admission_rule: All six formal claims and the post-seal family comparison must independently enumerate one unique survivor, pass four unfavorable controls, reconstruct under an implementation-distinct validator and enter through the untouched sealed engine in dependency order.
empirical_rule: Authoritative source bytes are opened only after the final family derivation seal; favorable, adverse, absent and unresolved rows remain separately recorded. Exact Fold values are claimed as structural results unless a source directly supplies the corresponding measured value.
prohibited_shortcuts: No V1/V2 result selects a survivor; it supplies only the question to reconstruct.
No narrower foundational claim is relabelled as completion of a stronger mechanism.
No external observation, consensus value or target label is opened before the derivation seal.
No first failed attempt is retired as a scientific result.
No engine, verifier, authority seal, prior receipt or prior claim is edited.
No numerical absence, negative, irrational, imaginary, floating, fitted or free proof magnitude is admitted.
